text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each substation's day-state noise (sigma_d) fitted by KD. The control shifts each hour band by its own random number of days, which destroys any structure shared between bands. Dashed line: 0.1, the level the shifted fits had to fall below. None did.'
text.tspan: Each substation's day-state noise (sigma_d) fitted by KD. The control shifts each hour band by its own random
number of days, which destroys any structure shared between bands. Dashed line: 0.1, the level the shifted
fits had to fall below. None did.
